    10	def fit_ses_effect(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    11	    """Logistic regression of BA DEGREE COMPLETED on SES (with intercept).

    13	    Returns a dict with keys: coef, std_err, p_value, odds_ratio, n.

    19	    # Include the intercept explicitly.  logaddexp keeps the log likelihood
    20	    # finite even when an optimizer proposes a large linear predictor.
    21	    design = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), x))

    23	    def negative_log_likelihood(beta: np.ndarray) -> float:
    24	        eta = design @ beta
    25	        return float(np.sum(np.logaddexp(0.0, eta) - y * eta))

    27	    def gradient(beta: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:

    32	    # good point even when the outcome is uncommon.
    33	    proportion = np.clip(np.mean(y), np.finfo(float).eps, 1.0 - np.finfo(float).eps)
    34	    initial = np.array([np.log(proportion / (1.0 - proportion)), 0.0])
